narration.prompt: [low, tense] Two in the morning, coming down the ghat road, there was something in my mirror. On all fours. And it was keeping up. [long pause] [calm, remembering] An hour before, on a bend above the village, a woman in a shawl had waved me down. Alone. No bag. [long pause] [quietly] She walked into my headlights, and I saw her feet. The heels were at the front. Her toes pointed back, down the road. [long pause] [hard] I didn't stop. I put my foot down. I hit her. [long pause] [shaken] In the camera, she gets up. The bones of her shins are through the skin. Her knees bend backwards. And she runs. [long pause] [breathless] Sixty. Seventy. Eighty, on a mountain road. I looked left. She was at my window, keeping pace. [long pause] [low, calm] The old drivers call her the chudail. They say never stop for her, and never look back. I didn't. I made it down by dawn. [long pause] [whispers] Then I watched the cabin camera. All the way down, a hand was resting on the back of my seat.

taxi.prompt: Inside an old diesel taxi driving fast down a mountain road at night: the rattling diesel engine, tyres on rough asphalt, wind roaring past the windows, the body creaking on the bends. No music, no voices, no horn.

bells.prompt: Small brass ankle bells jingling in a fast running rhythm on bare feet, close, dry, with the slap of bare feet and hands on asphalt, someone running on all fours. No music, no voices.

impact.prompt: A car hits a person at speed: a heavy dull thud on the bumper and bonnet, a sharp crack of bones breaking, a body rolling on the road. No screams, no music.

bones.prompt: Close, wet, slow cracking and grinding of broken bones, joints popping and snapping back the wrong way, as a broken body pushes itself up off the ground. No voices, no music.

nails.prompt: Long fingernails slowly tapping and scraping on a vinyl car seat back, very close, inside a car. No voices, no music.

hills.prompt: A pine forest on a Himalayan hillside at night: cold wind in the pines, crickets, a distant dog barking far down the valley, an idling diesel car nearby. No music, no voices.

brakes.prompt: An old car braking hard on a gravel-edged mountain road, tyres skidding and crunching on grit, the engine dropping to idle. No music, no voices.
